exposure: surgical transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block with 0.25% bupivacaine
outcome: total dose of rescue analgesics (tramadol) required
cohort: The study included 100 women undergoing cesarean delivery at MVJ Medical College and Research Hospital.
finding: Surgical TAP block significantly reduced postoperative pain, extended the time to first rescue analgesia, and decreased total tramadol consumption in women after cesarean delivery compared to a control group.
